title: Release coordination
description: Coordinates release preparation, qualification, publication and recovery around an exact candidate and applicable authority.
responsibilities: Determine eligible release identity and prepare profile-owned projections without inventing upstream version or compatibility decisions.
Qualify and retain a candidate, bind publication authority to it, and perform only its authorized publication steps.
Observe actual public outcomes, retain durable closeout, and select recovery from known external state rather than blindly repeating uncertain writes.

Consume IF-009 for applicable governed-action authority and IF-010 for exact-subject evidence applicability and coverage. Keep those separate findings tied to the selected candidate while retaining release-specific qualification, sealing, publication, and actual outcome responsibility.
Require exact packaged browser qualification through IF-005 and distinct reference-site evidence before any authorized product or documentation publication.
owned_state: Release preparation context, retained candidate references, qualification/authorization associations, and publication observations and closeout records; source product definitions and registry state remain distinct authorities.

includes: Routine release coordination, preparation, qualification, publication, observation, and recovery within the current Release contract.
excludes: Novel product decisions inside routine publication, approval inferred from a test pass, mutable release identities, claiming public success from local generation, or republishing to repair lost reporting.

design_limits: Existing Release owns channels, exact candidate identity, authorization, external-write failure classes, and closeout. This draft does not approve or execute a release.

IF-009/IF-010 define authority/evidence cooperation. MOD-006/MOD-007 retain the contributing behavior; applicable authority cannot replace evidence and supporting evidence cannot grant authority. The parent MOD-019 README supplies IR-010 composition and the SR-067–073 allocation rationale; SR-088 retains AR-050. Further collaboration outside this scope remains separately accountable.

Publication readiness, provider authentication/conflict checks, later public observations, and recovery still require the owning release analysis and execution evidence. Realization mapping and full migration of source-specific maintenance obligations remain separate work.

sources.basis: Proposed responsibility derived from the published-product source inventory. Existing Designs retain their detailed contracts; this allocation is not a runtime migration or approval.

sources.locator: MOD-015; SCN-019, SCN-053, SCN-066 selected collaboration analysis
sources.basis: Derive consumer-focused parent contracts for selected-state inspection, adopted-REM authoring guidance, applicable action authority, and evidence applicability. Preserve child behavior/state authority, existing Function/AR allocations, and earlier contract guarantees. The selected contracts refine prior blanket deferrals; remaining retention, wider collaboration, AR, and realization gaps stay explicit. This is draft design analysis, not implemented or satisfied behavior.

System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
